messages.author: 194004d81259bcfd
messages.subject: software for Affymetrix SNP arrays 6.0
parts:
Dear list,

I have a question which are not really specific to aroma-affymetrix,
but I think it's a good place to ask.
As how I understand it, the latest aroma-affymetrix is not ready for
Affy SNP 6.0 arrays. Is there any other software (from Affy or other places)
which can estimate the copy numbers for 6.0?

Thanks!
Yu Chuan

> Affy SNP 6.0 arrays. Is there any other software (from Affy or other
> places)
> which can estimate the copy numbers for 6.0?

I don't think there are any software doing CN for the 6.0 (nor the
5.0) chip. The aroma.affymetrix package can almost do it as is; what
remains to be solved is to create an annotation file specifying the
chromosome location for all SNPs/CNPs.

/Henrik

messages.author: 21b017a58b9d207c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: software for Affymetrix SNP arrays 6.0
parts:
Hi.
The UC Berkeley Functional Genomic Lab is considering the purchase of a license for the Partek software, which does analysis of CN for the 6.0 chip.  There is a free webinar about this very topic tomorrow.  You can sign up by going to the link of that webinar on the list here:
 http://www.affymetrix.com/corporate/events/index.affx
 
I would appreciate any feedback from anyone who watches the webinar about how well Partek does this type of analysis.  kv
